assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only mushoku-tensei:eris@light-novel#character-model, the canonical Eris bounded reconstruction model (generation V1, revision 1.7) at basis_commit, read in full as reviewed repository analysis of the locked Japanese light novels V01-V15, with direct Eris evidence in V02-V06, V09-V10 and V13-V15 and inspected illustrations used only as presentation evidence. The model routes its observations to an evidence index, the shared state and readiness ledger, per-volume deep readings and checkpoint syntheses, none of which is curated on this subject or used as evidence here. The project's current-state entrypoint was read for method and gate state only. No web novel, later light-novel volume, adaptation, performed voice or reception material is in scope.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: The model's eighteen selectors MT-EM-ST01 to ST18: V02 household pupil and later learning, gifts and boundaries (ST01-ST02); V03-V04 displacement, crossing, village peer ties and departure at thirteen, soon fourteen (ST03-ST04); V05 independent hunt, first human killing and Paul disagreement (ST05-ST06); V06 training, mountain attack, home loss and chosen training departure (ST07-ST08); the V09 disclosure of Sword Sanctuary arrival about two years earlier and the extra-frame present at seventeen (ST09-ST10); V10 solitary practice and the Auber encounter (ST11); V13 reciprocal training with Nina and Isolte and the rest advice (ST12-ST13); V14 stated limits against Orsted and the Sword King transmission with intended return (ST14-ST15); and V15 letter recipient, collective rescue fighter and prospective spouse, and household newcomer and wife (ST16-ST18). V07-V08 and V11-V12 supply no observed state, the V10 rank prolepsis is not present mastery, no earlier state acquires later knowledge and nothing after V15 is established.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The model gives six conditional rules (MT-EM-001 to 006) for task-specific learning through demonstration and trusted instruction, forceful intervention for a threatened valued person with proportionality in question, acceptance of care alongside overreliance and failed information transfer, peer friendship and repair, gifts and explicit boundaries, and direct written speech, each with a countercase and a discriminating observation and with per-volume applicability notes through V15. Rules 002 and 004 are left UNTESTED for their exact triggers across several later volumes, mechanism confidence is moderate, all calibration is retrospective fitting under disclosed prior familiarity, and the model names the transfer of restraint beyond valued relationships as its central uncertainty, so B is not supported. Explicit, falsifiable rules with countercases exceed a descriptive profile, so D is not supported.

Eighteen selectors run from the V02 household pupil to the V15 wife and household newcomer, each with a knowledge limit (for example ST08 does not know Rudy's rejection interpretation, ST11 does not know of his marriage, ST16 departure is not marriage acceptance), and each rule carries a per-volume extension or an explicit no-equivalent note, with the rule that no earlier state acquires later knowledge and with retrospective disclosure kept distinct from the dates motives began (V06, V09). The selectors are one-line labels whose transitions are owned by the uncurated shared state ledger, and she is offstage in V07-V08 and V11-V12, so B is not supported; a developmental sequence with knowledge limits per state exceeds an undifferentiated profile, so D is not supported.

Rule MT-EM-006 characterizes her written speech only in prose: direct demands and refusals, a repeated simple evaluative term, emphasis under emotion, hesitation, tears and quiet acceptance, intentional compression that assumes comprehension (V06), unusually expansive talk about a valued topic (V09), a terse threatening demand (V10) and concrete explanation and clarification requests (V13-V15). It quotes no Japanese wording, self-reference, ending or address form, gives no register locus beyond observation numbers, and excludes actor loudness, timbre and mechanical catchphrases, so D is not supported; the register is affirmatively characterized with countercases, so NOT_ASSESSED would ignore it.

Located ordinary items include enjoyment of food and excursions, practical camp adaptation, sadness at selling the mount, curiosity about places, boredom when others fill every camp role, a cooking-instruction request refused by Geese without a blow (test MT-EM-V05), a shopping choice and long-standing adventure wish (V05), food curiosity, guild banter and dragon-hunt enthusiasm (V06), a chosen bath (V13) and failed domestic and work attempts with an apology inside household support (V15). The model refuses universal domestic skill or a modern-school persona and gives each item in a clause, so C is not supported; several distinct located ordinary acts across volumes exceed a single mention, so E is not supported.

The model separates recipients: Ghislaine as prior mentor whose authority and protection matter independently of Rudeus; Rudeus as valued teacher and companion whose account repeatedly misreads her and whose romance script must not override her refusals; Ruijerd as trainer; Minitoona and Tersena as peers she teaches; Geese as a refusing cooking teacher; continued distrust of Paul with an independent debt to Therese (V05); refusal of Cliff; local rivalry and reciprocal exchange with Nina and Isolte (V13-V15); protection and teaching of Norn; and accommodation from the other wives (V15). The relationship section is one paragraph, most contrasts are a clause in a rule cell and the peer-repair rule rests on one cluster, so B is not supported; relation-conditioned response ranges across many recipients and states exceed a single relational sketch, so D is not supported.

The model records focalized access in several states: V05 focalized desire, fear and appraisal in an independent day; V06 retrospective interiority exposing idealization and fear of replacement; the V09 extra frame with affection and insufficiency; V10 alternating practice and reflection where the source directly gives the cost of thinking about the absent relationship; her own aim in the V14 interlude; and earlier insecurity revealed by the V15 interlude. Its D0 level is stated to cover interiority. Each is summarized in compressed lines, mechanism confidence is moderate, and the model forbids turning inferred motive outside that access into verbatim thought, so B is not supported; repeated located focalized material across six volumes exceeds limited local self-report, so D is not supported. This is the claim closest to D.

Conflict is the subject of a dedicated rule with falsifiers: excessive retaliation (V03), tearful nonviolent defense of Ghislaine against an always-hits reading and a moderated friend fight (V04), the Cliff conflict, revenge-seeking and defensive killing (V05), intervention despite fear (V06), an unorthodox combat record and defeat by Gal (V09), an attack on an obstructing visitor that persists after disarmament until Gal stops it (V10), structured training bouts (V13), refusal to seek a title by killing her teacher (V14), and a protective rescue role, a punch at a friend and an explicit bluff threat (V15); test MT-EM-V05 shows frustration without a blow. The exact valued-person defense trigger is UNTESTED after V06, escalation and restraint mechanisms are only partly verbalized and transfer of restraint is the model's central uncertainty, so B is not supported; repeated located conflict with explicit countercases exceeds distributed description, so D is not supported.

The model locates morally weighted choices: excessive retaliation and later restraint, a defensive first killing, refusal of a political role, refusal to seek rank by killing a teacher, stated willingness to die protecting Rudeus (intention only), and the household-entrance bluff. It keeps proportionality an open comparative question, says combat doctrine is not unlimited ethical permission and rates general emotional regulation INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; her weighing is not elaborated, so C is not supported. Repeated located choices with countercases exceed a single local mention, so E is not supported.

The model mentions guild banter, dragon-hunt enthusiasm and enjoyment of excursions in passing, but locates no humorous or playful instance and models no function for play. Absence of located evidence is not treated as a trait or an inability.

One curated item: a compact model covering her V02-V15 appearances through six rules, eighteen selectors and thirty-two retrospective checks, with all observations routed to an evidence index, a shared state ledger, deep readings and checkpoint syntheses that are not curated on her row. The model declares itself BOUNDED_PROVISIONAL with no clean holdout, and V15 is the authorized terminal volume, so C is not supported; systematic coverage of every admitted volume in which she appears exceeds limited local evidence, so E is not supported.

Every rule has a countercase, and the model locates affirmative limits and errors: literacy and magic uneven against sword and dance, a forest mistake and need for knight help despite superior sword skill (V05), notices seen but not passed on because Rudy was presumed informed (V05), a short departure note whose meaning she assumed understood (V06), defeat by Gal (V09), escalation stopped by Gal (V10), loss to matchup-specific counters (V13), no victory over Orsted (V14-V15), and failed domestic and work attempts with an institutional misreading (V15). Each limit is a clause and calibration is retrospective with prior familiarity, so B is not supported; located errors and countercases exceed bare gap statements, so D is not supported.

Each selector is bound to a volume and to observation numbers, with ages where the source gives them (thirteen, soon fourteen at ST04; explicitly seventeen at ST10), an explicitly dated flashback (ST09 about two years before the extra frame), a V10 rank prolepsis kept distinct from present mastery and the rule that no earlier state acquires later knowledge. B is not supported because selectors are one-line labels, transitions are held by an uncurated state ledger and two offstage stretches leave no state; D is not supported because knowledge is bounded per state rather than given as a loose period.

scenario_readiness.note: The model characterizes her register only in prose and quotes no wording; it shows that her direct words can conceal reasons and produce opposite interpretations, and it excludes performed voice. CONDITIONAL would generate speech from a prose register description; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the characterized register and its countercases.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: Any single named selector MT-EM-ST01 to ST18 between V02 and V15, with that state's knowledge only; nothing after V15 and no later knowledge in an earlier state.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Only attested recipients in their state-specific relation: Rudeus as tutor, companion and later husband; Ghislaine as mentor; Ruijerd as trainer; Paul, Therese, Cliff, Geese, Minitoona and Tersena within their located contacts; Gal, Nina, Isolte and Auber at the Sword Sanctuary; Norn and the other wives in the V15 household.
setting_constraints: The Boreas household, the travel routes, the Sword Sanctuary, the rescue and the household of the Japanese light novels V02-V15
No modern setting, institution or technology outside the source
No unseen skill, literacy, domestic competence, diagnosis, adult-intimacy scene or future knowledge
Near-analog situations only; materially novel contexts end in abstention

scenario_readiness.note: The model permits D0 represented behavior and only D1 near-analog extension within named contexts, says all admitted domains remain BOUNDED_PROVISIONAL and that unfamiliar situations require abstention, and rates general emotional regulation, unfamiliar politics, adult intimacy and audiovisual performance INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; its checks are retrospective under prior familiarity and its central uncertainty is whether restraint transfers beyond valued relationships. CONDITIONAL would extend a near-analog license to materially novel contexts the model declines; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore its explicit application bounds.

Located ordinary social material is a set of clauses (food, excursions, camp roles, a refused cooking request, banter, a bath choice, failed household work), and the model refuses universal domestic skill or a modern-school persona. CONDITIONAL would build ordinary social behavior from summary clauses; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the located items.

The evidence locates outcomes of morally weighted choices (retaliation, a defensive killing, refusal to kill a teacher for rank, a stated willingness to die) but summarizes rather than shows her weighing, keeps proportionality an open question and rates general emotional regulation INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE. CONDITIONAL would supply deliberation the model does not elaborate; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the located choices.

The model locates affection and a stated future hope, a stopped unwanted act, the V15 confession, a noncombat proposal accepted and actual assent alongside pace tension, but rates adult intimacy INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, rejects consent inferred from attachment, training or the future diary, says marriage gives no blanket consent and bars generated sexualized scenarios. CONDITIONAL would build a romantic persona from located acts the model keeps bounded; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore those acts.

conditions: Only attested sword-training and combat-practice situations as near analogs: drills, sparring, technique explanation and exchange, teaching a junior and cooperative defense.
Competence stays sword-domain specific: no literacy, magic, domestic, institutional or political competence is generated from rank or skill.
Fallibility is retained: defeat, need for help and matchup-specific losses stay possible, and rank is not general mastery or victory over Orsted.
Output is behavior described in prose; no quoted speech is generated as canonical, and the selected state's knowledge only.
scenario_readiness.note: Rule 001 is the model's most extended rule: sword practice through frustration and defeat, application of several teachers' lessons, sustained Sword Sanctuary training, technique sharing with Nina and Isolte, adaptation of North-style force into speed, teaching Norn and adaptation under a superior opponent in the V15 rescue, with located limits (needs help, loses to counters, never defeats Orsted). Readiness is conditional because the model rates task-sensitive learning BOUNDED_PROVISIONAL with moderate mechanism confidence, allows only near-analog use and locates failed non-combat work in V15. READY would treat compressed rule cells as a professional procedure; NOT_READY would deny the most broadly located domain in the evidence.

known_limits.statement: High sword competence and rank do not imply literacy, magic, cooking, domestic or institutional skill, political knowledge or emotional regulation; the model locates uneven literacy and magic and failed V15 domestic and work attempts.

Neither forceful intervention nor restraint is a default: the model locates excessive retaliation and continuing force beside nonviolent defense, a moderated fight and a refused request met without a blow, and leaves the exact valued-person defense trigger UNTESTED after V06.
Affection, limited permission under care dependency, training, the future diary and marriage do not establish consent; the model requires actual assent and rates adult intimacy INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.

Her direct, compressed speech can conceal reasons and produce opposite interpretation (the V06 note, the V10 demand); direct words are not shared understanding, and the voice evidence quotes no Japanese wording.
Rudeus's account repeatedly misreads her; her choices are not to be fitted to his romance script, and his knowledge and interpretations are not hers.

All thirty-two checks are retrospective fits with disclosed prior familiarity, not clean holdouts or numerical prediction scores; scene confidence is high and mechanism confidence moderate, and no domain is DOMAIN_READY.

The evidence index, shared state ledger, deep readings and checkpoint syntheses to which the model routes its observations are not curated on this subject, so its observation locators were not rechecked here and no independent reconstruction test is in the evidence set. Missing support is not evidence of absence.
Nothing after V15 is in evidence; later states, knowledge and development are not assessed, and V07-V08 and V11-V12, where she is offstage, supply no state.
No humorous or playful instance is located, so humor and play are not assessed; this is a gap, not evidence that she lacks humor.
